fraction_basis: Normalized over the modeled crystalline phases; no amorphous or external-standard correction.
model_uncertainties: The WO3 metric and intensity pattern favor P -1, but closely related monoclinic P21/c remains a plausible structural alternative at laboratory resolution.
Reported fraction ESDs are internal least-squares values and do not include phase-model or profile-model systematic uncertainty.
weighting: GSAS-II 1/Y counting-statistics weights because the input supplied counts without standard uncertainties.
